secrets.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Google AI (Gemini) API key for the Volt 360 AI Assistant, roof scan panel detection, and utility bill analysis. Optional at boot — without it the app starts and the AI features report 'not configured'.

secrets.name: GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY
secrets.description: Google Maps/Cloud API key for the Solar API roof data and satellite tiles, also served to the browser for map display. Optional at boot — without it the roof scan reports 'not configured'.
